plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree.

plugins.name: grill-with-docs
plugins.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design in a repo, writing resolved terms into CONTEXT.md and hard-to-reverse decisions into ADRs as you go.

plugins.name: grill-spec
plugins.description: Interview the developer about what to build and why in a repo, writing problems, user stories, journeys, and acceptance criteria into a versioned spec file, refining it against consistency and opposing perspectives before accepting.

plugins.name: beads
plugins.description: Beads issue tracking workflow for Claude Code. Always create a beads issue before starting any task, update it during work, and close it on completion.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust development workflow with rust-analyzer LSP integration

plugins.name: madr-writer
plugins.description: Author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) in MADR format in the location resolved by the project-layout skill (docs/internal/adr/ by default).

plugins.name: refine-design
plugins.description: Critically pressure-test and refine a design decision — surface alternatives and trade-offs, and check consistency with existing decisions.

plugins.name: context-budget
plugins.description: Measure Claude Code context usage (baseline breakdown + per-session growth) and reduce it with evidence.

plugins.name: workflow-graph
plugins.description: Run work as a graph of three strongly connected components (design / build / review) with saved workflows, ledgers, and enforced exit conditions.

plugins.name: clear-writing
plugins.description: Write reports, docs, and replies so readers can follow the logic without rereading.

plugins.name: project-layout
plugins.description: The standard project layout (where README, AGENTS.md, ADRs, specs, the glossary and public docs live) and how to resolve each location, as a reference skill and a machine-readable layout.json.

plugins.name: init-project
plugins.description: Check a repository against the standard project layout (README, LICENSE, AGENTS.md, docs/public, docs/internal/adr, ...) and create only the missing files.

plugins.name: glossary
plugins.description: The glossary format (CONTEXT.md / CONTEXT-MAP.md) — term definitions, structure lines (kind, is-a, disjointness, coverage, overlap) and cross-term sections (relations, axioms, consequences, cases) — as a single reference skill.

plugins.name: ontology
plugins.description: Add structure to the glossary (CONTEXT.md) — kinds, is-a, disjointness and coverage, relations with multiplicities, axioms, expected consequences, possible/impossible cases — grill it, sync it with specs and code, and verify it with static checks or Alloy.

plugins.name: agent-kaizen
plugins.description: File an agent-experience pain point or wish as a GitHub issue on dotagents, for the autonomous improvement loop.

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: ADRs as executable specifications for coding agents
